item.title: Geopolitics and grain don't mix, say these Montana farmers
item.description: Farmers in states bordering Canada say they are reeling from President Trump's trade wars and resulting retaliatory tariffs. And it's just not neighborly.

item.title: SCOTUS rejects Trump's mail voting limits. And, the Kennedy Center financial crisis
item.description: The Supreme Court has rejected Trump's mail-in voting restrictions ahead of the midterm elections. And, the Kennedy Center says it is on the brink of bankruptcy and could close soon.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Air pollution spiked after the Trump administration stopped embassy monitoring
item.description: In 2025, the Trump administration ended a long-running program to collect air pollution data at U.S. embassies. A new study suggests that led to a 24-33% increase in local pollution levels.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: NATO jets shoot down a drone in Lithuanian airspace
item.description: The incident came less than a day after NATO leaders pledged that strikes close to the alliance's territory would drive the trans-Atlantic organization to increase support for Kyiv.

item.title: Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon to share a stage to promote curbs on AI
item.description: The poles of U.S. politics are coming together over AI. Sanders and Bannon will appear at the "Pro-Human Assembly" in Washington, D.C., to convince Congress to work faster to curb the impact of AI.

item.title: For thousands of Haitians in the U.S., end of protected status brings fear, grief and defiance
item.description: Haitians in the U.S. lost their Temporary Protected Status under Trump's immigration crackdown. Now facing deportation to a homeland wracked by gang violence, disease and extreme poverty, Haitians in Miami are meeting the moment with grief, anger, and courage.
